dataSource: Wikidata Action API; bounded search and one 22-entity batch
notes: Data contains 12 Puerto Rico and 10 global records.
Coordinates are Wikidata statements with their declared precision, not independently surveyed points. Preserve precision rather than implying precision from decimal count.
Official page links are references; their text and photographs are not covered by Wikidata CC0.
Wikimedia Commons images, OSM footprints and third-party CAD require their own rights records.
No live visitor queries, geocoding or tile requests are required to use this seed.
Nine linked schematics are original normalized drawings. Metadata and coordinates do not establish model accuracy.
